adaptations.pe_binding: /* PE-Reborn: no trusted_apps carveouts, as in the OS3.0.8.0 firmware. */
adaptations.reason: The stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM firmware (vendor_boot Cape DTBs) no longer reserves trusted_apps_region@ea000000 (57 MiB) or trusted_apps_ext_region@ed900000 (59 MiB); its other 54 reserved-memory regions match this source exactly. No node or driver of our kernel references trusted_apps_mem or trusted_apps_ext_mem, so keeping them only withholds about 116 MiB of RAM from Linux under the OS3 TrustZone.

adaptations.pe_binding: size = <0 0x3000000>; /* PE-Reborn: OS3.0.8.0 firmware size */
adaptations.reason: The stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM firmware (vendor_boot Cape DTBs) uses a newer memory-dump table: a 48 MiB mem_dump_region instead of 52 MiB, no CPU/L3/LLCC/GEMNOC scan-dump entries and the fsm_data, osm_reg and pcu_reg entries. The table is read by the TrustZone/SDI crash-dump firmware, which is the OS3 firmware on the device, so it is taken from stock: 97 entries in stock order with stock dump ids and sizes.

adaptations.pe_binding:
<&adsp_smp2p_in 3 0>,
					<&adsp_smp2p_in 7 0>;

		interrupt-names = "wdog",
				"fatal",
				"handover",
				"ready",
				"stop-ack",
				"shutdown-ack";
adaptations.reason: In the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot the ADSP and CDSP PAS nodes take a sixth interrupt, bit 7 of their SMP2P slave-kernel input named shutdown-ack, through which the OS3 DSP firmware acknowledges a graceful shutdown; drivers/remoteproc/qcom_sysmon.c of our kernel requests it by that name.

adaptations.pe_binding: qcom,fastrpc-slpi-sensors-pdr;
adaptations.reason: the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot registers the sensors protection-domain restart on SLPI, where mondrian's sensors run (remoteproc-slpi), not on ADSP; drivers/char/adsprpc.c of our kernel reads both properties.

the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot votes CX per GPU power level (qcom,cx-level, read by drivers/gpu/msm/adreno.c); frequencies and GX levels already equal stock. Without it CX is under-voted where the GX level is below the CX corner stock requests (e.g. 710 MHz: GX 224, CX NOM).
the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot makes the qseecom CMA heap uncached (qcom,uncached-heap, read by drivers/dma-buf/heaps/qcom_dt_parser.c).

adaptations.pe_binding: /* PE-Reborn: U1/U2 entry allowed, as in OS3.0.8.0. */
adaptations.reason: the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot no longer disables USB3 U1/U2 entry on the DWC3 core (drivers/usb/dwc3/core.c).

adaptations.pe_binding:
<&clock_gcc GCC_USB3_PRIM_PHY_COM_AUX_CLK>,
			<&clock_gcc GCC_USB3_0_CLKREF_EN>;
		clock-names = "aux_clk", "pipe_clk", "pipe_clk_mux",
				"pipe_clk_ext_src", "ref_clk_src",
				"com_aux_clk", "ref_clk";
adaptations.reason: the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot gives the USB3/DP combo PHY a seventh clock, ref_clk = GCC_USB3_0_CLKREF_EN, which gates the 38.4 MHz reference its PLL sequence uses; our phy-msm-ssusb-qmp.c enables an optional ref_clk and our gcc-waipio.c registers GCC_USB3_0_CLKREF_EN for Cape.

adaptations.reason: the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot programs the USB3/DP combo PHY with Qualcomm's newer sequence: the QSERDES PLL runs from the 38.4 MHz CLKREF (CMN_CONFIG_1 0x04, DEC_START 0x104, DIV_FRAC 0x5D555 for both modes, the same ~9998 MHz VCO as the 19.2 MHz x4 setting of the source) with matching SSC steps, and the RX UCDR gain, RX equalizer modes and signal-detect level are retuned. Our phy-msm-ssusb-qmp.c applies the same <offset value delay> triplets terminated by 0xffffffff, so the stock register values are used in our format.

the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot adds two Coresight trigger generation units for the SPMI buses (coresight-tgu-spmi0/1, periphid 0xbb999, 9 registers) next to the IPCB unit of the source; stock loads coresight-tgu.ko from vendor_dlkm and recovery, and our coresight-tgu.c (CONFIG_CORESIGHT_TGU=m) matches the same AMBA id and reads the same tgu-* properties.

the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot also names i2c5 = qupv3_se17_i2c (i2c@888000), as waipio.dtsi does. The controller is disabled on mondrian, but the highest i2c alias sets the first dynamic bus number, so runtime adapters such as the DisplayPort AUX DDC get the same numbers as on stock.

the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot lists the PHY, PARF and DBI registers that pci-msm.c dumps when the PCIe0 link (QCA6490 WLAN) fails; our pci-msm.c reads the same qcom,phy-debug-reg, qcom,parf-debug-reg and qcom,dbi-debug-reg properties. Diagnostics only; link setup is unchanged.

adaptations.pe_binding:
<&clock_gcc GCC_USB30_PRIM_SLEEP_CLK>;
		/* PE-Reborn: GCC_USB3_0_CLKREF_EN is the USB3 PHY ref_clk, as in OS3.0.8.0. */
		clock-names = "core_clk", "iface_clk", "bus_aggr_clk",
					"utmi_clk", "sleep_clk";
adaptations.reason: the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot no longer gives the DWC3 controller the xo clock: GCC_USB3_0_CLKREF_EN is held only by the USB3 PHY (ref_clk) while the PHY is initialized, so it is off in USB2-only use. Our dwc3-msm-core.c treats xo as optional, the eUSB2 PHY has its own GCC_EUSB3_0_CLKREF_EN, and our phy-msm-ssusb-qmp.c enables ref_clk before the PHY reset.

the Xiaomi source enables the PM8350B haptics with the generic pm8350b.dtsi defaults (2700 mV, 5102 us = 196 Hz), while the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM device tree drives the mondrian LRA at 1250 mV maximum with a 5882 us (170 Hz) resonance period; our qcom-hv-haptics.c uses both for the drive voltage cap and the initial auto-resonance period, so the stock tuning of this motor is used.

adaptations.pe_binding: debounce-interval = <32>; /* PE-Reborn: as OS3.0.8.0 */
adaptations.reason: the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM device tree debounces the volume-up key (PM8350 GPIO 6) for 32 ms instead of 15 ms; gpio_keys.c reads debounce-interval.

the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot programs PCIe0 with Qualcomm's PHY revision 99: SSC step size and PLL fractional divider for a 9998 MHz VCO (as the USB3 PHY), and an updated RX setting on each lane (0x60, 0x64, 0x90, 0x94, 0x98, 0xe3c). The <offset value delay> format and the rest of the sequence are unchanged, and our pci-msm.c applies it as is; qcom,pcie-phy-ver is only printed.

the stock OS3.0.8.0.VMNCNXM Cape DTB of vendor_boot programs PCIe1 with Qualcomm's PHY revision 99: SSC step size and PLL fractional divider for a 9998 MHz VCO (as the USB3 PHY), and an updated RX setting on each lane (0x60, 0x64, 0x90, 0x94, 0x98, 0xe3c, 0x163c). The <offset value delay> format and the rest of the sequence are unchanged, and our pci-msm.c applies it as is; qcom,pcie-phy-ver is only printed.
